title: 2.4. Code Comments & PEP 8 Documentation Standards
summary: Learn why code documentation matters, how to use single-line comments (#), and adhere to PEP 8 Python style conventions.
learningObjectives: Insert explanatory comments using the hash mark (#).

sections.heading: 2.4.1 The Role of Comments in Production Software
sections.content:
A comment is a non-executable textual remark intended exclusively for human engineers. When CPython encounters a hash mark (#), it ignores all remaining characters on that line.

Good comments explain INTENT, ALGORITHMIC REASONING, and EDGE CASES, rather than trivial syntax repetitions.

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Which symbol initiates a single-line comment in Python?
knowledgeChecks.explanation: Python uses the hash symbol (#) to denote comments.

recap: Comments document code purpose and engineering rationale, ignored by the interpreter.
